title: Do Health Insurers Matter for Health Outcomes? Evidence from a Large Natural Experiment in Colombia
title_zh: 健康保险公司对健康结果有影响吗？来自哥伦比亚一项大型自然实验的证据
authors: Giancarlo Buitrago, Paul Rodríguez-Lesmes, Natalia Serna, Marcos Vera-Hernández
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: While the relationship between health insurance coverage and health outcomes has been extensively studied, there is limited evidence on which specific features of insurance matter. We address this gap by leveraging the abrupt termination of Colombia’s largest health insurer and examining the spillover effects on patients who were not enrolled with the terminated insurer. The termination caused a 10% decrease in the breadth of provider networks among incumbent insurers and a 20% increase in mortality rates. We show two mechanisms drove the change in mortality: increased congestion stemming from the surge of enrollees at incumbent insurers and reduced provider network breadth. Insurers narrowed their networks by excluding higher-quality providers that served sicker, more expensive patients, whoin turn died at much higher rates than their counterparts. Findings suggest insurers play a key role in patient health through their provider networks.
abstract_zh: 尽管健康保险覆盖与健康结果之间的关系已被广泛研究，但关于保险具体特征如何影响健康结果的证据仍然有限。我们利用哥伦比亚最大健康保险公司的突然终止，考察其对未参保于该终止保险公司的患者产生的溢出效应，从而填补这一研究空白。该保险公司的终止导致现有保险公司的医疗服务提供者网络广度下降10%，死亡率上升20%。我们揭示了驱动死亡率变化的两种机制：因参保者涌入现有保险公司而导致的拥堵加剧，以及医疗服务提供者网络广度的缩减。保险公司通过排除那些服务于病情更重、医疗费用更高患者的优质医疗服务提供者来收窄其网络，而这些患者的死亡率远高于其他患者。研究结果表明，保险公司通过其医疗服务提供者网络在患者健康中发挥着关键作用。

title: Rebuilding the world order: Two strategies for a fragmented world
title_zh: 重建世界秩序：碎片化世界的两种策略
authors: Dennis Snower
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: As the postwar international order fragments and universal agreement becomes increasingly elusive, policymakers face a pressing question: what form of cooperation can replace the postwar hegemon-led, rules-based system? This column examines two complementary answers. Mark Carney argues that coalitions of middle powers can preserve stability, resilience, and strategic autonomy in an era of great-power rivalry. The author of this column proposes a broader architecture of pivotal power coalitions organised around human flourishing, policy alignment, and polycentric governance. Their dialogue illuminates one of the defining policy challenges of our time: how to combine geopolitical realism with effective collective action. Together, these approaches offer a practical roadmap for building a more resilient, cooperative, and problem-solving world order.
abstract_zh: 随着战后国际秩序碎片化，普遍共识愈发难以达成，政策制定者面临一个紧迫问题：何种合作形式能够取代战后由霸权主导、基于规则的国际体系？本专栏探讨了两种互补的答案。马克·卡尼认为，中等强国联盟可以在大国竞争时代维护稳定、韧性与战略自主。本专栏作者则提出一个更宏大的架构，即围绕人类繁荣、政策趋同与多中心治理构建关键力量联盟。两者的对话揭示了当代最具挑战性的政策议题之一：如何将地缘政治现实主义与有效的集体行动相结合。这些路径共同为构建更具韧性、更富合作精神且能有效解决问题的世界秩序提供了切实可行的路线图。

title: Physician Learning and Forgetting: Evidence from the US Military
title_zh: 医师学习与遗忘：来自美国军方的证据
authors: Trevor Fitzgerald, Atul Gupta, Stephen D. Schwab
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Physicians in the U.S. military health care system are quasi-randomly assigned to combat deployments, leading to gaps of varying durations in their clinical practice. We leverage this unique setting to provide novel causal evidence on skill depreciation (forgetting) and learning-by-doing among physicians. We find robust evidence that readmission rates increase by 48% in the first two months after a surgeon returns from a deployment. However, surgeons return to baseline performance within 6 months of resuming practice. In contrast, obstetricians maintain elevated cesarean section rates for up to 9 months, implying a deeper change in clinical judgment. Finally, we interpret these patterns through the lens of a learning model and estimate learning-by-doing rates for surgeons and obstetricians. A doubling of recent procedure volume reduces readmission and C-section rates by 17% and 11% for surgeons and obstetricians, respectively.
abstract_zh: 美国军事医疗体系中的医生被准随机分配至战斗部署任务，导致其临床实践出现不同时长的中断。我们利用这一独特情境，为医生技能折旧（遗忘）与干中学效应提供了新颖的因果证据。研究发现，外科医生从部署返回后的前两个月内，患者再入院率显著上升48%。然而，在恢复临床实践6个月内，其诊疗水平即可回归基线。相比之下，产科医生的剖宫产率在长达9个月期间持续处于高位，这暗示其临床判断发生了更深层的改变。最后，我们通过学习模型框架对这些模式进行解读，并估算了外科医生与产科医生的干中学速率：近期手术量每翻一番，外科医生的再入院率与产科医生的剖宫产率将分别降低17%与11%。

title: The Effects of Competition in the Retail Gasoline Industry
title_zh: 零售汽油行业竞争的影响
authors: Reid Taylor, Erich Muehlegger
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the effect of competition on incumbent firm pricing by using high frequency price data and the precise geographic location for all gas stations in California. Using an event study design, we find that the entry of a new station is associated with a 2.5 cent decrease in prices at incumbent stores, which equates to a 7% reduction in estimated retail markups. The effects are immediate, persistent, and show no sign of deterrence or limit pricing behavior. In contrast, nearby exit results in precisely estimated null effects on prices with no evidence of predatory pricing in the lead up to the station departure. The results are consistent across all fuel blends and dissipate with station distance. Finally, we explore the asymmetric effects, showing that the difference cannot be attributed to difference in branding, proximity to highway, or data quality idiosyncrasies, although we find suggestive evidence that exit tends to happen in more competitive markets and amongst less heavily trafficked stations.
abstract_zh: 我们利用高频价格数据和加利福尼亚州所有加油站的精确地理位置，估算了竞争对现有企业定价的影响。通过事件研究设计，我们发现新加油站的进入导致现有门店价格下降2.5美分，相当于零售加价幅度减少7%。这种影响是即时且持久的，没有表现出任何威慑或限制性定价行为的迹象。相比之下，附近加油站的退出对价格产生了精确估计的零效应，且在退出前未发现掠夺性定价的证据。所有燃料混合物的结果均一致，并随距离增加而减弱。最后，我们探讨了非对称效应，表明这种差异不能归因于品牌差异、高速公路邻近性或数据质量特性，尽管我们发现了暗示性证据，即退出往往发生在竞争更激烈的市场以及交通流量较少的加油站中。

title: Hedging interest rate risk when it matters: Evidence from Italian banks
title_zh: 关键时期的利率风险对冲：来自意大利银行的证据
authors: Michele Leonardo Bianchi, Dario Ruzzi, Anatoli Segura
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Valuation losses can build quickly in response to higher interest rates, as demonstrated by the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank. This column shows that Italian banks do hedge against interest rate risk and, crucially, increase hedging when rates rise. This suggests banks actively adjust hedging intensity through derivatives, consistent with a state-dependent model of risk management. Institutions with lower capital ratios, a larger share of wholesale funding, and a smaller deposit base hedge more aggressively. These findings highlight the importance of considering derivative exposure in stress-testing frameworks, as derivatives are a key channel through which banks absorb shocks.
abstract_zh: 利率上升可能导致估值损失迅速累积，硅谷银行的倒闭便印证了这一点。本文研究表明，意大利银行确实会对冲利率风险，且关键的是，当利率上升时，它们会加大对冲力度。这表明银行通过衍生品主动调整对冲强度，这与风险管理的状态依存模型相符。资本充足率较低、批发融资占比更高、存款基础较小的机构，其对冲行为更为激进。这些发现凸显了在压力测试框架中考虑衍生品敞口的重要性，因为衍生品是银行吸收冲击的关键渠道。

authors: Michael Bauer, Daniel Huber, Eric Offner, Ole Wilms

abstract: We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize. (JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56)
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们通过利用大语言模型对新闻文章进行分类并结合人工验证，构建了一个包含美国上市公司时间戳企业脱碳承诺（绿色承诺）的新数据集。无论行业内部还是跨行业，发布绿色承诺的企业通常规模更大且碳排放强度更高。绿色承诺显著推高了股票价格，这与碳溢价的降低相一致，并预示着未来碳排放量和排放强度的大幅下降。这些效应在棕色行业的企业中最为显著。因此，绿色承诺具有可信度，向投资者传递了相关的新信息，并为脱碳提供了有意义的财务激励。（JEL G14, G32, Q54, Q56）

title: The Potential Market for Care in East Asia and Pacific
title_zh: 东亚及太平洋地区照护服务的潜在市场
authors: Esham, Nadia, Halim, Daniel, Mattoo, Aaditya
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Markets and public institutions must anticipate evolving care demand driven by East Asia and the Pacific’s exceptionally rapid demographic transition. To this end, this paper develops the Care Simulation Model, a demographic model that estimates gaps in childcare and eldercare needs. By integrating publicly available demographic data, the model captures both care needs and the availability of family caregivers across life cycles and cohorts, allowing the assessment of how demographic shifts may change reliance on family-based care. The paper quantifies unmet family care needs and translates them into estimates of potential market size, defined as the share of households likely to require care services outside the family and the corresponding potential employment creation in childcare and eldercare. By 2030, the childcare needs of an estimated 25 percent of households and the eldercare needs of 7 percent of households in ASEAN-5 countries may not be met within the family. After accounting for family availability and current care employment, the unmet need across 21 countries in East Asia and the Pacific translates into a potential gap of 19.9 million jobs in childcare and 34.1 million jobs in eldercare. The model offers a transparent, cross-country framework to inform care policy, workforce planning, and investment strategies.
abstract_zh: 市场和公共机构必须应对东亚及太平洋地区异常快速的人口转型所驱动的不断变化的照护需求。为此，本文开发了照护模拟模型，这是一种估算儿童照护和老年人照护需求缺口的人口模型。通过整合公开可得的人口数据，该模型捕捉了生命周期和队列中的照护需求及家庭照护者的可得性，从而评估人口结构变化如何改变对家庭照护的依赖。本文量化了未满足的家庭照护需求，并将其转化为潜在市场规模估计，定义为可能需要家庭外照护服务的家庭比例，以及儿童照护和老年人照护中相应的潜在就业创造。到2030年，东盟五国中约25%家庭的儿童照护需求和7%家庭的老年人照护需求可能无法在家庭内部得到满足。在考虑家庭可得性和当前照护就业后，东亚及太平洋地区21个国家的未满足需求转化为儿童照护领域1990万个潜在就业缺口和老年人照护领域3410万个潜在就业缺口。该模型提供了一个透明的跨国框架，为照护政策、劳动力规划和投资策略提供信息。

abstract: This paper proposes a validation framework for LLM-generated measurements when reliable benchmarks are unavailable. Validity is established by testing whether an LLM can reconstruct passages from annotated labels while maintaining semantic consistency with the original text. The framework avoids circular reasoning by establishing testable prerequisite properties that must be met for a validation to be considered successful. Application to news article data demonstrates that the framework serves as a practical alternative to human benchmarking, which offers advantages in objectivity, scalability, and cost-effectiveness while identifying cases where LLMs capture economic meaning that human evaluators miss.

abstract: We construct and estimate a small open economy DSGE model featuring a regime-switching reserve requirement (RR) ratio rule within a banking sector that has access to foreign assets. The model incorporates key financial characteristics of the Chinese economy and examines the implications of changes in the RR-ratio. Estimation results reveal that the RR-ratio follows a feedback rule with a regime-dependent coefficient on net foreign lending during two distinct phases between 2006 and 2017. The state-contingent rule is temporarily suspended during the Global Financial Crisis, but is reactivated in the post-crisis period amid recovered capital inflows. On the one hand, the RR-ratio has almost negligible real effects on output and inflation; but on the other hand, it proves effective as a macroprudential instrument by mitigating financial instability through a reduced risk of self-fulfilling bank runs by about 25%.
abstract_zh: 我们构建并估计了一个小型开放经济DSGE模型，该模型在拥有外国资产的银行部门中引入了具有体制转换特征的法定存款准备金率规则。模型纳入了中国经济的核心金融特征，并考察了法定存款准备金率变动的经济影响。估计结果显示，在2006年至2017年间的两个不同阶段，法定存款准备金率遵循一个反馈规则，该规则对净外国贷款的系数具有体制依赖性。这一状态依存的规则在全球金融危机期间被暂时中止，但在危机后随着资本流入恢复而重新激活。一方面，法定存款准备金率对产出和通胀的实际影响几乎可以忽略不计；但另一方面，它作为宏观审慎工具被证明是有效的，通过将自我实现的银行挤兑风险降低约25%，从而缓解了金融不稳定。

title: Chinese Export Gains, EU Export Losses, and Russian Import Reorientation after the 2022 Sanctions
title_zh: 2022年制裁后中国出口增长、欧盟出口损失与俄罗斯进口转向
authors: Sjöholm, Fredrik
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how Russian imports were reoriented after the 2022 sanctions. Using annual bilateral trade data at the product level, it asks whether direct Chinese export gains to Russia were concentrated in the same product lines in which EU exports to Russia declined. It also studies rerouting through Hong Kong, Armenia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Türkiye. The results point to substantial post-2022 import reorientation in Russia. Direct Chinese export gains are larger in product lines where Russia had depended more heavily on EU suppliers before the sanctions. Including transit-linked flows strengthens this relationship and points to broader rerouting through intermediary economies in those same product lines. In sanction-relevant goods, direct Chinese gains offset only part of the EU shortfall, while intermediary-country channels account for a substantial additional share. On the EU side, product-level evidence also suggests that some of the lost Russian market was absorbed through higher exports of the same products to other non-transit destinations. The evidence is therefore consistent with partial direct substitution by China, broader rerouting through intermediary economies, and partial outward redirection by EU exporters, not full replacement of lost EU exports.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2022年制裁后俄罗斯进口如何实现重新定向。利用产品层面的年度双边贸易数据，研究聚焦于中国对俄直接出口增长是否集中于欧盟对俄出口下降的同类产品线，并探讨了经由香港、亚美尼亚、哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和土耳其的转运路径。结果表明，2022年后俄罗斯进口出现了显著重新定向。在制裁前俄罗斯更依赖欧盟供应商的产品线上，中国直接出口增长更为显著。纳入转运关联流量后，这一关系得到强化，表明同类产品线通过中间经济体的转运范围更广。在制裁相关商品中，中国直接出口增长仅部分弥补了欧盟供应缺口，而中间经济体渠道则贡献了相当可观的额外份额。从欧盟方面看，产品层面证据亦表明，部分失去的俄罗斯市场份额被同一产品对其他非转运目的地的出口增长所吸收。因此，证据支持中国部分直接替代、通过中间经济体的广泛转运以及欧盟出口商的部分向外转向，而非对欧盟流失出口的完全替代。
